CITY OF HAWAIIAN GARDENS  Tuesday, December 12, 2023
CITY COUNCIL MINUTES  Regular Meeting, 6:00 PM

Victor Farfan, Mayor Pro Tem  Ernesto Marquez, City Manager
Dandy De Paula, Council Member  Megan Garibaldi, City Attorney
Luis Roa, Council Member  Pablo Rubio, City Clerk
Ernie Vargas, Council Member
  Maria Teresa Del
  Rio, Mayor

  MINUTES
CALL TO ORDER

The City Council meeting was called to order on Tuesday, December 12, 2023 at 6:02 PM.

INVOCATION

The invocation was led by Pablo Rubio, City Clerk.

FLAG SALUTE

The flag salute was led by Councilmember De Paula.

ROLL CALL
PRESENT

  Councilmember De Paula
  Councilmember Roa
  Councilmember Vargas
  Mayor Pro Tem Farfan
  Mayor Del Rio
ABSENT
  None
Pablo Rubio, City Clerk, announced a quorum.

PUBLIC COMMENTS - GENERAL OR ITEMS ON OR OFF THE AGENDA

There were no Public Comments.

PROCLAMATIONS AND CERTIFICATES

 1.  PRESENTATIONS TO MAYOR MARIA TERESA DEL RIO AND THE MAYOR’S
  FAREWELL COMMENTS

  Mayor Del Rio spoke.

   Dr. Gina Zietlow, Superintendent, ABC Unified School District, spoke.

  Sophia Tse, ABCUSD President of the Board, spoke.

  Dan Holguin, Captain, Lakewood Sheriff’s Station, spoke.

  Councilmember Roa spoke.

  Mayor Pro Tem Farfan spoke.

  Councilmember De Paula spoke.

 2.  REORGANIZATION OF MEMBERS OF THE CITY COUNCIL

  Pablo Rubio, City Clerk, opened the nominations for the position of Mayor and all
  committees the Mayor serves on such as Public Housing Authority, Successor Agency to
  the RDA, and Public Finance Authority.

  Councilmember Roa nominated Mayor Pro Tem Farfan for Mayor.

  Pablo Rubio, City Clerk, closed nominations for Mayor.

  A motion was made by Councilmember Roa, to appoint Mayor Pro Tem Farfan as
  Mayor.

  The motion was Carried by the following vote:

  AYES: 5; De Paula, Roa, Vargas, Farfan, Del Rio
  NOES: 0;
  ABSENT: 0;
  RECUSE: 0;

  Motion Carried: 5–0–0–0

  Pablo Rubio, City Clerk, opened the nominations for the position of Mayor Pro Tem and
  all committees the Mayor Pro Tem serves on such as Public Housing Authority,
  Successor Agency to the RDA, and Public Finance Authority.

  Mayor Del Rio nominated Councilmember De Paula for Mayor Pro Tem.

  Pablo Rubio, City Clerk, closed nominations for Mayor Pro Tem.

DECEMBER 12, 2023 Page 2
   A motion was made by Mayor Del Rio, to appoint Councilmember De Paula as Mayor
  Pro Tem.

  The motion was Carried by the following vote:

  AYES: 5; De Paula, Roa, Vargas, Farfan, Del Rio
  NOES: 0;
  ABSENT: 0;
  RECUSE: 0;

  Motion Carried: 5–0–0–0

 3.  RECOGNITION OF FRANK AMARO FOR OVER 30 YEARS OF DEDICATED SERVICE
  TO THE HAWAIIAN GARDENS LITTLE LEAGUE PROGRAM

  Mayor Del Rio presented a certificate to Frank Amaro.

 4.  CERTIFICATES FOR THE HAWAIIAN GARDENS EAGLES - SECOND PLACE FINISH
  AT THE 2023 SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA MUNICIPAL ATHLETIC FEDERATION, FLAG
  FOOTBALL TOURNAMENT

  Mayor Del Rio presented certificates to the Hawaiian Gardens Eagles participants.

PRESENTATIONS

 1.  UPDATE FROM THE LA COUNTY OFFICE OF THE VIOLENCE PREVENTION (OVP),
  TRAUMA PREVENTION INITIATIVE (TPI)

  This presentation was continued to the Wednesday, January 10, 2024, City Council
  meeting.

 2.  PRESENTATION BY ANJELIQUE GRANADOS, COMMUNITY LIBRARY MANAGER,
  HAWAIIAN GARDENS LIBRARY

  Anjelique Granados, Community Library Manager, Hawaiian Gardens, spoke.

  Mayor Del Rio declared a recess at 6:51 PM.

  Mayor Del Rio called the meeting back to order at 7:23 PM.

AGENDA ORGANIZATION

A Presentation of Certificates was added to the agenda for the Hawaiian Gardens Eagles,
Second Place Finish at the 2023 Southern California Municipal Athletic Federation, Flag
Football Tournament; and the Reorganization of the City Council was moved after all
presentations.

A motion was made by Councilmember Roa, seconded by Mayor Del Rio, to approve the
Agenda Organization.

 A.  PUBLIC HEARING(S) / HEARING(s)

There were no Public Hearings.

 B.  CONSENT CALENDAR

 1.  WAIVE READING IN FULL OF ALL ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS ON THE
  AGENDA

  That the City Council waive reading in full of all ordinances and resolutions on the
  agenda and declare that said titles which appear on the public agenda shall be
  determined to have been read by title and further reading waived.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  A motion was made by Councilmember Roa, seconded by Councilmember De Paula, to
  adopt Consent Calendar as presented, in its entirety.

  The motion was Carried by the following vote:

  AYES: 5; De Paula, Roa, Vargas, Farfan, Del Rio
  NOES: 0;
  ABSENT: 0;
  RECUSE: 0;

  Motion Carried: 5–0–0–0

  FY 2023-2024 Proposition A funds between the City of Hawaiian Gardens and the City of
  La Habra Heights, California and authorizing the City Manager to execute all necessary
  documents.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  A motion was made by Councilmember Roa, seconded by Councilmember De Paula, to
  adopt Consent Calendar as presented, in its entirety.

 C.  DISCUSSION ITEM(S)

 1.  Recommendation to accept the construction improvements by Best Contracting
  Services, Inc., for C. Robert Lee Roof Replacement, Project 102 and authorize the City

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  Neema Ghanbari, Public Works Manager, provided the staff report.

  Mayor Pro Tem De Paula spoke.

  A motion was made by Councilmember Roa, seconded by Mayor Del Rio, to approve

  The motion was Carried by the following vote:

 D.  COMMITTEE REPORT(S)

There were no Committee Reports.

 E.  NEW BUSINESS

There were no New Business items.

 F.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Joe Jimenez, Recreation and Community Services Director, announced that Santa will be
coming to town on Thursday, December 14, 2023, for Santa’s Neighborhood Parade.

Councilmember Roa spoke.

Mayor Pro Tem De Paula spoke.

 G.  CITY ATTORNEY REPORT(S)

There were no City Attorney Reports.

 H.  ORAL COUNCIL REPORT(S)

Councilmember Vargas showed a video for the Hawaiian Gardens Eagles.

Councilmember Roa reported that he attended the Christmas Tree Lighting Event, City Holiday
Party, and Breakfast with Santa.

Councilmember Del Rio reported that she attended the Christmas Tree Lighting Event, and the
City Holiday Party.

Councilmember Roa expressed appreciation to Eric Leon, Recreation Coordinator and Iliana
Arechiga, Sr. Recreation Leader III for their hard work.

Mayor Pro Tem De Paula reported that he attended the Christmas Tree Lighting, Breakfast with
Santa, and wished everyone a happy holiday.

Councilmember Vargas thanked Recreation Director, Joe Jimenez and his recreation staff for
their hard work.

Mayor Farfan thanked staff for their hard work this year.

John Natalizio, City Attorney, read the Closed Session Items into the record.

The City Council recessed to Closed Session at 7:46 PM

The City Council reconvened from Closed Session at 8:25 PM.

Pablo Rubio, City Clerk, conducted a roll call and announced a quorum.

John Natalizio, City Attorney, stated no reportable action from Closed Session.

 J.  ADJOURNMENT

The City Council adjourned the meeting at 8:26 PM to the next Regular City Council meeting to
be held on Wednesday, January 10, 2024 at 6:00 PM.
